Market today: The mood is decidedly negative for tech and chip names, driven by the significant news surrounding Nvidia's leadership. This directly impacts your highly concentrated portfolio.

Your holdings: SOXL (-70.62%), MUU (-49.58%), and SPAL (-45.57%) are in deep drawdowns and are leveraged, meaning margin amplifies these drops. These positions need immediate attention.

Watch: Closely monitor the fallout from the Nvidia news and its ripple effect across the entire semiconductor sector. Pay particular attention to your stops on all leveraged positions.

Bottom line: Extreme caution and risk management are paramount given the sector-specific headwinds and your leveraged exposure.
plays: Review SOXL (down 70.62%) and MUU (down 49.58%). Given the Nvidia news and their leveraged nature, consider trimming to reduce exposure.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The significant negative news in the chip sector outweighs any mechanical long setups for now.
